@realm:     Essence
@name:      Brewing Lore
@category:  Training Package

# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.

 1 | Identify Drug | 1 sample | - | self | I
 2 | Brew Alcohol | 4 gallons | 1 week | 1' | F
 3 | Identify Poison | 1 sample | - | self | I
 4 | Detect Poison/Intoxicant | 1'R | C | 10' | I
 5 | Soriel’s Brew | caster | 1 hour | self | U
 6 | Devlin’s Cure | caster | 1 hour | self | U
 7 | Syleg’s Relief | caster | 1 hour | self | U
 8 | Brew Minor Poison | caster | 12 hours | self | U
 9 | Risteard’s Relief | caster | 1 hour | self | U

11 | Brew Healing Herbs | caster | 1 hour | self | U
12 | Alicon’s Cure | caster | 1 hour | self | U

14 | Brew Major Poison | caster | 12 hours | self | U
15 | Jemer’s Philtre | caster | 1 hour | self | U
16 | Magic Cauldron | 1 cauldron | 24 hours | self | F
17 | Beaver’s Brew | caster | 1 hour | self | U
18 | Brew Antidote | caster | 1 hour | self | U
19 | Brew Truth Potion | caster | 1 hour | self | U
20 | True Brew | caster | 1 hour | self | U
25 | Magic Cauldron True | 1 cauldron | 24 hours | self | F
30 | Poison True | caster | 24 hours | self | U
50 | Philosopher’s Elixir | caster | 1 year | self | F

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster knows the origins, purity, and general worth of any one drug sample.
Any impurity will be known. Alternatively, this spell provides a +25 to the
skill Drug Lore.
@@ 2
Caster causes some base to rapidly ferment into an alcoholic beverage (beer,
wine, etc). This spell can also be used to distill whiskey, brandy, etc. at
one quarter a cubic foot per level of caster.
@@ 3
As Identify Drug, except poison is known. Alternatively, this spell provides a
+25 to the skill Poison Lore.
@@ 4
Caster is aware of the presence of all drugs and poisons in the area of
effect. Caster may concentrate on a different 1'R each round. If the
poison/drug was mixed with food by a Brew spell, the poison/drug may make a RR
to resist detection.
@@ 5
Enables the caster to prepare one dose of a stimulant through a chemical
process from natural ingredients. The drug will have an effective duration of
one hour and act as if it were the level of the caster for RR purposes. A
person affected by a stimulant is at +10 for all actions for the duration of
the drug.
@@ 6
As Soriel’s Brew, except induces unconsciousness, stupor, or a state of
insensibility (rendering the patient unable to act).
@@ 7
As Soriel’s Brew, except a person affected is relieved of queasiness and
vertigo. Alternatively, Syleg’s Relief may be brewed to cause nausea.
@@ 8
Allows caster to prepare, handle, and contain a known poison of up to 10th
level potency.
@@ 9
As Soriel’s Brew, except a person affected is relieved of sneezing, rashes,
watery eyes and other allergy symptoms.
@@ 10
As Soriel’s Brew, except a person affected is -10 to all actions, but very
happy. Additionally, a it will put the person into a sleep-like trance within
5 to 30 minutes of taking it. The Addiction Factors may be anywhere from 10 to
double the caster’s level (caster’s choice).
@@ 11
Caster may distill the essence of any healing herb into a portable potion that
will keep indefinitely. The caster may also combine a healing herb with
appropriate herbal catalysts (healing in nature) to create up to a 50% more
powerful potion than the original healing herb.
@@ 12
As Soriel’s Brew, except this medicine will reduce the effects of a parasitic
infestation, killing parasites on contact. This medication’s Addiction Factor
may be anywhere from 10 to double the caster’s level.
@@ 13
Allows caster to prepare, handle, and contain a known acid.
@@ 14
As Brew Minor Poison, except allows caster to work with any poison up to 20th
level potency.
@@ 15
As Soriel’s Brew, except a person affected may add +30 to all perception
rolls.
@@ 16
Caster may brew any lower level spell on this list in 75% the normal time by
mixing it in the target cauldron. For the purposes of this spell, any
pot-shaped container may be considered a cauldron.
@@ 17
As Soriel’s Brew, except a person affected by an hallucinogenic is at -50 to
all actions, but he is very happy and experiencing wild hallucinations. This
medication’s Addiction Factor may be anywhere from 15 to double the caster’s
level.
@@ 18
Caster may make one dose of a drug that acts as the antidote to one type of
poison (determined at the time of brewing).
@@ 19
As Soriel’s Brew, except drug lasts for 1 hour only. A person affected by this
drug must tell the whole truth for the duration.
@@ 20
As Brew Healing Herbs, except any herb may be processed into a potion with up
to a 50% increase in power.
@@ 25
As Magic Cauldron, except caster may brew any lower level spell on this list
in half the normal time.
@@ 30
As Brew Minor Poison, except allows caster to work with any poison.
@@ 50
The caster produces the “elixir of life.” This potion returns the person who
drinks it to a youthful state. The target’s age will drop to one-third its
current age. Additionally, the elixir prolongs life so that ten passing years
seems as only one to the person who drinks it. This potion may only be imbibed
once by a person. Someone who takes a second drink will immediately and
painfully die. Elves who drink this elixer experience no effect other than to
suffer violent retching.
